# PARADOX

> PARADOX is a public web platform for discovering AI agents, inspecting GitHub projects, running practical AI workflows, and using browser-based developer utilities.

## Core
- https://paradox.engineer/
- https://paradox.engineer/agents/ — discover public GitHub projects
- https://paradox.engineer/verify/ — analyze a public GitHub repository
- https://paradox.engineer/compare/ — compare public repositories
- https://paradox.engineer/trending/ — discover trending public projects

## AI
- https://paradox.engineer/ai-studio/ — unified AI Studio with five AI workflows, 16 developer tools, and live AI radar signals

## Browser tools
- https://paradox.engineer/utilities/ — practical browser utilities (separate general-purpose utility library)
- https://paradox.engineer/use-cases/ — task-focused generators
- https://paradox.engineer/daily/ — daily browser challenge
- https://paradox.engineer/world/ — world data utilities

## Trust and policy
- https://paradox.engineer/about/
- https://paradox.engineer/privacy/
- https://paradox.engineer/terms/
- https://paradox.engineer/contact/

Automated repository analysis is based on public evidence and static indicators available at analysis time. It is not a security certification, safety guarantee, or manual code review.
